title: Intellicheck and DESKO to Showcase Biometric Desktop Identity Verification at Money20/20 Las Vegas
body_markdown:
*Companies Will Demonstrate How DESKO Document-Capture Hardware and Intellicheck’s Real-Time Identity Validation Technology Can Perform Desktop Identity Verification with In-Person Biometrics*


**


‍


MELVILLE, N.Y.– October 12, 2026 – Intellicheck, Inc. (Nasdaq: IDN) (“Intellicheck” or the“Company”), an industry-leading identity verification company delivering proprietary, on-demand digital and physical identity validation solutions, today announced that it will showcase its advanced identity verification integration with DESKO at Money20/20 Las Vegas, taking place October 18-21, 2026, at The Venetian.


‍


At Intellicheck Booth 14106, attendees can see demonstrations of Intellicheck’s identity verification and unique barcode analysis technology that spans in-person, digital, and mobile use cases. This showcase includes the debut of a prototype DESKO PENTA Scanner® 4X with an integrated biometric camera, connected to Intellicheck’s identity verification service. The solution demonstrates how purpose-built document-capture hardware, identity validation software, and biometric facial capture can support a fast, consistent point-of-transaction workflow. DESKO, at Booth 5071, will demonstrate and discuss its full product line and capabilities.


‍


For banks and financial technology providers, bringing these capabilities into a coordinated workflow is designed to reduce handoffs between systems, support faster verification decisions, and provide a seamless experience during face-to-face customer interactions. The combined approach can support teller-counter, desktop, and self-service use cases while helping institutions make more informed identity verification decisions.


‍


“Fraudsters have gotten faster, better funded, and more convincing, which means the moment of in-person verification can no longer rely on a human glance at a photo ID,”said Bryan Lewis, CEO of Intellicheck. “By pairing DESKO’s scanner and integrated camera with Intellicheck’s identity verification technology, we’re giving businesses a way to use in-person biometrics to confirm that the person standing at the counter is actually the person on the credential, in real time and at the point of transaction. This collaboration reflects where identity verification is headed: physical and digital checks converging into a single, trusted moment of truth, and we’re proud to be building toward that with DESKO.”


‍


“Combined biometric solutions are the future of identity verification. They provide a higher level of security while making verification processes more convenient for both organizations and end users,” said Werner Zahn, Managing Director of DESKO. “Together with Intellicheck, we are demonstrating how trusted ID document verification in combination with biometric capture can create a more secure, efficient and user-friendly verification infrastructure for our customers.”


‍


Money20/20 attendees can visit Intellicheck at Booth 14106 to see DESKO hardware operating with Intellicheck’s identity verification technology, including the new prototype. The PENTA Scanner 4X prototype with an integrated biometric camera will be displayed at DESKO Booth 5071.


‍ **‍**


**About DESKO**


DESKO is your trusted provider of ID document verification and automated data capture solutions. From security, border, and access control to KYC and tax refund processes, DESKO offers high-quality solutions based on 35 years of industry experience. Combining high-performance hardware with seamlessly integrated software, DESKO connects physical and digital ID document verification, helping to streamline identity checks into secure and efficient workflows.


‍


Developed and manufactured in Germany, more than 500,000 DESKO solutions are in use in over 135 countries worldwide. They help businesses and government authorities capture and verify identities quickly, securely, and efficiently across a wide range of industries.


‍


For more information on DESKO, visit us on the[web](https://www.desko.com/en/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/desko-gmbh/) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/DESKO.global) , and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Deskovideo) .


‍


**About Intellicheck**


Intellicheck (Nasdaq: IDN), the industry leader in identityverification management, prevents the use of unauthorized IDs to stopidentity-based fraud. Intellicheck is the onlySaaS-based validation and proofing service that uses a unique and proprietaryanalysis of DMV-issued IDs to create trusted, real-time customer identityverification experiences across a wide variety of sectors, both in-person anddigitally. Intellicheckis processing identity transactions for almost half the adult population in theUnitedStates and Canada annually with state-of-the-art technology solutions that are providing a seamless, invisible ID verificationexperience while delivering 99.975% decisioning in under a second when a customeris using our tools to capture the document. For more information on Intellicheck, visit us on the[web](https://intellicheck.com/?utm_source=pr) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intellicheck-inc-) ,[X](https://twitter.com/IDNIntellicheck) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/intellicheckidn/) , and[YouTube](https://youtube.com/user/ICMOBIL) .
